newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht weaker, interbank rate steady late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht weaker, interbank rate steady late.

text.p: The Thai baht was lower against the dollar in late trade on Tuesday following the greenback's rise in overseas markets, dealers said.
"People rushed to buy the dollar today after it rose sharply against the yen abroad," said one dealer at a local bank.
The baht was quoted at 26.065/26.070 to the dollar late against 26.052/26.055 in the early morning.
The central bank set the mid-rate at 26.04 to the dollar versus 26.06 on Tuesday.
The overnight interbank rate was steady at 7.25-7.50 percent near the close against 7.50 in the morning, dealeres said.
"There was not much activity in the market today. Most banks had already squared their position since last week," said one money market dealer.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was traded unchanged at 5.75/6.25 satangs per dollar.
